title: 第17章 族比到来不速之客第18章 姜家到来苏清雪的态度
content_zh:
当清晨的第一缕阳光破开云层，照耀到武安城之时，叶府，也开始喧闹了起来。
今日，便是叶家族比之日。
当叶无尘与叶夕月赶到演武场的时候，这里早已人声鼎沸，不少陌生的面孔出现在此地。
叶家在武安城属于绝对的霸主级势力，甚至就连武安城的城主府都不敢轻易得罪叶家。
因此每一年，叶家族比之日都会有不少势力前来观摩。
一来是为了攀个关系，二来是想看看叶家年轻一辈弟子的实力。
毕竟对于家族势力来说，年轻一辈的天赋越高，也就代表着家族的未来越发强大。
若是年轻一辈都是庸人，那这家族怕是也要断代了。
此刻，在演武场的贵宾席之上，不少世家的高层皆围坐在此地，彼此之间不断的交谈起来。
而在贵宾席的中间位置，一名面容阴柔的男子正面带笑意的与武安城诸多世家高层谈笑。
此时，他的目光刚好瞥见了一旁的叶无尘，脸上的表情瞬间就阴沉了几分。
往年的族比叶无尘根本就不会露面。
原本他还以为今年的族比，叶无尘会在叶南天的包庇下继续躲起来。
没想到这次竟然还真的敢出现。
在这阴柔男子的身后，则是站着两名叶家弟子。
赫然就是与叶无尘产生冲突的叶宇跟叶青两兄弟。
再看这阴柔男子的面容，应该就能看的出来。
此人就是两人的父亲，叶家的四长老，叶玉涛。
此刻叶宇断裂的左臂已然恢复，想必叶玉涛是付出了不小的代价才将叶宇的手臂给治好了。
而此时，这一家子三人皆是一脸阴沉的看向叶无尘。

对于这三人的注视，叶无尘却是毫不在意，连看都没看他们一眼。
然而，就当他从三人身旁经过之时，叶玉涛却是叫住了叶无尘。
只见他手握茶杯，一脸讥讽的看向叶无尘，“叶少主今日怎么舍得离开你那小院子了？”
叶无尘脚步一顿，转头看向了叶玉涛，一脸淡漠的开口道，“此事跟四长老好像没有什么关系吧？”
见到叶无尘的淡漠反应，叶玉涛怔了一下。
他似乎能从叶无尘淡漠的语气中，感觉到一股发自内心的厌恶。
这不禁让他感到十分不舒服，当即收敛了笑容，淡淡开口道：
“跟我倒是没有什么关系，但今天可是叶家的族比，你作为我叶家少主，代表的可是整个叶家，你若是丢人，整个叶家都要跟着丢人。”
听闻此话，叶无尘看向叶玉涛，一字一顿的开口道：
“关你屁事。”
话音落下，叶无尘不再理会叶玉涛，当即从他身前经过，朝不远处叶家少主所在的位置走了过去。
“不知者无畏。”
叶无尘的举动，让叶玉涛面色十分难看，不由得开口嘲讽了一句。
“玉涛兄，想必这位便是你们叶家那位被称为绝世妖孽的废物少主吧？”
叶玉涛身旁，一名世家长老开口问道。
“什么绝世妖孽，要我看，不过是一个废物瞎子罢了。”
另一名世家的长老嗤笑开口道。
两人嘲笑的话语让叶玉涛的心情顿时好了不少，于是朝身旁的两人开口道：
“诸位还不知道吧，我儿叶青不久前已经突破到了炼体九重，今日过后，叶家少主的位置多半就不是他叶无尘的了。”
“哈哈哈，那就静待叶青贤侄的好消息了。”
content_en:
When the first ray of sunshine in the morning broke through the clouds and shone into Wu'an City, Ye Mansion also began to become noisy.
Today is the day of the Ye family competition.
When Ye Wuchen and Ye Xiyue arrived at the martial arts arena, the place was already bustling with people, and many unfamiliar faces appeared here.
The Ye family is an absolute hegemonic force in Wu'an City. Even the city lord's palace in Wu'an City does not dare to offend the Ye family easily.
Therefore, every year, many forces come to watch the Ye family competition.
Firstly, it was to establish a relationship, and secondly, it was to see the strength of the younger generation of disciples of the Ye family.
After all, for family power, the higher the talent of the younger generation, the stronger the future of the family.
If all the younger generation are mediocre, then this family will probably die.
At this moment, at the VIP seats in the martial arts arena, many senior members of the aristocratic families were sitting around, chatting constantly with each other.
In the middle of the VIP table, a man with a feminine face was smiling and chatting with many senior officials of Wu'an City's aristocratic families.
At this time, his eyes happened to catch a glimpse of Ye Wuchen beside him, and the expression on his face instantly turned gloomy.
Ye Wuchen, the clan leader from previous years, will not show up at all.
Originally, he thought that Ye Wuchen would continue to hide under Ye Nantian's protection during this year's clan competition.
Unexpectedly, he actually dared to show up this time.
Behind this feminine man stood two Ye family disciples.
Surprisingly, it was the two brothers Ye Yu and Ye Qing who had a conflict with Ye Wuchen.
You should be able to tell it by looking at this feminine man's face.
This person is their father, Ye Yutao, the fourth elder of the Ye family.
At this moment, Ye Yu's broken left arm has recovered. Ye Yutao must have paid a heavy price to heal Ye Yu's arm.
At this time, all three members of the family looked at Ye Wuchen with gloomy expressions.
Ye Wuchen didn't care about the gazes of these three people, and didn't even look at them.
However, when he passed by the three people, Ye Yutao stopped Ye Wuchen.
He was seen holding a teacup in his hand and looking at Ye Wuchen with a sarcastic expression, "Why are you so reluctant to leave your little courtyard today, Young Master Ye?"
Ye Wuchen paused, turned to look at Ye Yutao, and said with an indifferent expression, "This matter has nothing to do with the Fourth Elder, right?"
Seeing Ye Wuchen's indifferent reaction, Ye Yutao was startled.
He seemed to be able to feel a sense of disgust from Ye Wuchen's indifferent tone.
This made him feel very uncomfortable. He immediately stopped his smile and said calmly:
"It has nothing to do with me, but today is the clan competition of the Ye family. As the young master of my Ye family, you represent the entire Ye family. If you are embarrassed, the entire Ye family will be embarrassed."
After hearing this, Ye Wuchen looked at Ye Yutao and said word by word:
"None of your business."
After the words fell, Ye Wuchen ignored Ye Yutao and immediately passed him and walked towards the location of the young master of the Ye family not far away.
“He who doesn’t know is fearless.”
Ye Wuchen's actions made Ye Yutao look very ugly, and he couldn't help but sneered.
"Brother Yutao, this must be the good-for-nothing young master of your Ye family who is known as the peerless evildoer, right?"
Next to Ye Yutao, an elder from a wealthy family asked.
"What kind of peerless evildoer, if I look at it, it's nothing more than a good-for-nothing blind man."
Another elder from aristocratic family sneered and said.
The two people's mocking words made Ye Yutao feel a lot better immediately, so he said to the two people beside him:
"You don't know yet, but my son Ye Qing has broken through to the ninth level of body refining not long ago. After today, the position of young master of the Ye family will probably not be his, Ye Wuchen's."
"Hahaha, then just wait for the good news about Ye Qingxian's nephew."
